CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi.
   C. Say The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Abrahamic Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Say Abrahamic Covenant has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Abrahamic Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Abrahamic Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Abrahamic Covenant.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.
   B. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.
   C. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of God’s Plan for Redemption with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Origin and Consequences of Sin with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.
   C. Say Origin and Consequences of Sin has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Origin and Consequences of Sin to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of Calming the Storm? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Calming the Storm with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Calming the Storm.
   C. Say Calming the Storm has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Calming the Storm to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
   A. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership in Israel: Saul has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Leadership in Israel: Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel: Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel: Saul.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.
   D. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Lost Sheep? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Lost Sheep to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Lost Sheep has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Lost Sheep.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Lost Sheep with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Origin and Consequences of Sin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
